rust.rationale: glib VariantStrIter has real undefined behaviour; >=0.20.0 is patched. This exact 0.18.5 package is a Linux GTK transitive dependency in the cross-platform lockfile and is absent from production/build trees for Mac arm64, Mac Intel and Windows x64. Every audit recomputes these trees; becoming reachable fails. This is not a Linux exception and does not declare the vulnerable crate safe. Review the Tauri GTK dependency chain before any Linux release.

The upstream maintainer is inactive and there is no patched version; this is maintenance debt, not an all-clear. This exact procedural macro is only reached through Linux GTK-derived build dependencies and is absent from Mac arm64, Mac Intel and Windows x64 production/build trees. Every audit proves absence, including build dependencies. A future reachable package/new advisory/version must be reviewed separately; a Linux release must revisit or migrate this dependency.
